definitions.full: H1021. Beth Hakkerem הַכֶּ֫רֶם בֵּית proper name, of a location in Judah ( vineyard place ) Jer 6:1 , ׳בּ הַכָּ֫רֶם Neh 3:14 ; on location compare Schick ZPV iii. 83 f. , but see editorial remarks ib. , & Bd Pal 136 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and 3754 with the article interposed; house of the vineyard;

occurrences.englishText: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

“Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the middle of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem, for evil looks out from the north with a great destruction.
